payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures and methods used for quality evaluation on a Q&A platform, particularly Zhihu Live.

claims.text: A data-driven approach is used to evaluate the quality of the Zhihu Live platform, which includes data collection, cleaning, normalization, descriptive analysis, and predictive analysis.
The dataset ZhihuLive-DB, containing 7242 records and 286,938 comments, is utilized for evaluating the quality of Zhihu Live.
The proposed method, MTNet, is designed to accurately predict the quality of Zhihu Live, achieving the best performance compared to baseline methods.
The analysis reveals insights about the quality of Zhihu Live, indicating that current data attributes are relatively unitary and that malicious comments are a concern.
